blocks.text: Stem cells munfarid (unique) cells hain jin mein jism ke bohat se mukhtalif cell types mein badalne ki hairat-angez salahiyat (ability) hai. Jab stem cell taqseem (divide) hota hai to har naye cell mein yeh imkan hota hai ke woh stem cell hi rahe ya makhsoos (specialised) cell ban jaye, jaise muscle cell, red blood cell ya dimagh ka cell.

blocks.title: Stem cell
blocks.text: Aisa cell jo taqseem se khud ko dobara bana bhi sakta hai aur ek ya zyada makhsoos cell types mein badal bhi sakta hai.
Qismein: kitne cell types bana sakte hain

items: Totipotent: tamam mumkin cell types mein badal sakte hain. Maslan zygote aur zygote ki pehli chand taqseemon se bane cells.
Pluripotent: taqreeban kisi bhi cell mein badal sakte hain. Maslan shuruati (early) embryo ke cells.
Multipotent: qareebi rishtedar cells ke ek khandan (family) mein badal sakte hain. Maslan haematopoietic stem cells red aur white blood cells ya platelets ban sakte hain.
Oligopotent: chand mukhtalif cell types mein badal sakte hain. Maslan baligh (adult) lymphoid ya myeloid stem cells.
Unipotent: sirf ek qisam ke cells, apni hi qisam, bana sakte hain. Phir bhi yeh stem cells hain kyunke khud ko dobara bana sakte hain. Maslan baligh muscle stem cells.

Regenerative medicine: stem cells mein khairab tissues aur organs ki marammat (repair) ya tabdeeli ki salahiyat hai, is liye yeh spinal cord ki chot, type 1 diabetes, Parkinson's disease aur dil ki beemari jaisi halaton ke ilaj mein istemal hote hain.

Dawaon ki jaanch aur tayyari: stem cells ko khaas cell types mein badal kar researchers insani beemariyon ke models banate hain, jis se dawaon ke asraat ki zyada durust jaanch hoti hai aur janwaron ke models par inhisar kam hota hai.

Personalised medicine: stem cells mareez ke apne cells se hasil kiye ja sakte hain, jis se ilaj mein immune rejection ka khatra kam hota hai. Yeh shakhsi tareeqa zyada moassar aur mehfooz ilaj de sakta hai.

blocks.text: ESCs blastocysts (shuruati embryos) ke inner cell mass se hasil kiye jate hain. Yeh pluripotent hain, is liye jism ke taqreeban tamam cell types mein badal sakte hain. Un ki oonchi differentiation salahiyat unhen research aur ilaj ke liye bohat kar-amad banati hai. ESCs ke istemal par akhlaqi (ethical) tashweesh mein insani embryos ka istemal, teratoma banne ka khatra aur mumkina immune rejection shamil hain.

Yeh stem cells jism ke mukhtalif tissues, jaise bone marrow, charbi (fat) aur khoon, mein milte hain. Yeh multipotent hain: apne asal tissue se juri mehdood cell types mein badalte hain. In ke istemal mein akhlaqi tanaza kam hai aur jab yeh mareez ke apne tissues se liye jayen to immune rejection ka khatra bhi kam. Magar in ki differentiation salahiyat mehdood hai aur inhen alag karna aur culture karna mushkil hai.
iPSCs laboratory mein baligh somatic cells ko khaas transcription factors se dobara program kar ke pluripotent halat mein laye jate hain. Yeh embryonic stem cells ki tarah pluripotent hain.

items: iPSCs ke faide: in mein embryonic stem cells se jure akhlaqi tanaze nahin, kyunke inhen embryos tabah karne ki zaroorat nahin. Yeh mareez ke apne cells se banaye ja sakte hain, jis se immune rejection ka khatra kam se kam hota hai. Yeh khairab tissues aur organs ko dobara banane ka imkan dete hain, jaise dil ke mareezon ke liye naye heart cells ya neurodegenerative beemariyon ke mareezon ke liye naye neurons.

iPSCs ke nuqsanat: dobara program karne ka amal genetic tabdeeliyan la sakta hai jo iPSCs par asar dalen. Mareezon mein lagane par yeh tumours (teratomas) bana sakte hain. iPSCs ko khaas, poori tarah kaam karne wale cell types mein badalna ab bhi pecheeda kaam hai, aur yeh yaqeeni banana ab bhi mushkil hai ke yeh cells theek kaam karen.

blocks.alt: Insani jism aur lambi haddi ke saath stem cells ke teen zariye: haddi ke gooday (bone marrow) se nikle stem cells jo dish mein adult stem cells ban kar barhte hain; jild (skin) se liye gaye fibroblasts jo dish mein barha kar reprogramming se induced pluripotent stem cells bante hain; aur blastocyst ke cells jo dish mein embryonic stem cells ban kar barhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Darja-bandi karen: (a) zygote, (b) haematopoietic stem cell, (c) baligh muscle stem cell, (d) shuruati embryo ka cell. Phir batayen ke stem cells ka kaun sa zariya embryo ki tabahi aur immune rejection dono se bachata hai, aur us ke istemal ka ek khatra batayen.
blocks.explanation: (a) Totipotent. (b) Multipotent. (c) Unipotent. (d) Pluripotent. Induced pluripotent stem cells dono se bachate hain, kyunke yeh mareez ke apne baligh cells se bante hain; khatron mein dobara programming se genetic tabdeeliyan aur teratoma banna shamil hain.

items: Stem cell khud ko dobara banata hai aur makhsoos ho sakta hai. Salahiyat ke lihaz se: totipotent (zygote), pluripotent (shuruati embryo), multipotent (blood stem cells), oligopotent (lymphoid, myeloid), unipotent (muscle stem cells).
Istemal: regenerative medicine, beemari ke models par dawaon ki jaanch, mareez ke apne cells se personalised medicine.

Asal ke lihaz se: embryonic (pluripotent; akhlaqi tashweesh, teratoma, rejection), adult (multipotent; kam akhlaqi masail, kam rejection, magar mehdood aur culture mein mushkil), induced pluripotent (dobara program kiye baligh cells; embryos nahin, kam rejection, magar genetic tabdeeliyan, teratomas aur simt dena mushkil).
